citation.journal: Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology

cited_by.title: Laser hair removal on dark skin

record.population: Participants with Fitzpatrick skin types III-VI in 12 comparative trials (9 randomised)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of lasers and IPL for hair reduction
record.finding: Alexandrite laser was superior to IPL for hair count; Nd:YAG and diode were not significantly different from IPL for hair count. Nd:YAG had fewer dark marks than IPL (OR 0.26). Diode and alexandrite had comparable safety to IPL, with more pain.
record.note: III-VI covers medium to dark skin; Black participants are not separated.
